definition: Measures how far the model's predictions are from the true labels. The model is penalized more heavily when it is very confident about a wrong answer.
The proportion of predictions the model got correct out of all predictions made.
The proportion of images where the correct species appears anywhere in the model's top 5 most confident guesses.
numerator: Images with True Class in Top 5

definition: Of all the times the model predicted a specific species, how often was it right? Calculated per species then averaged equally across all 525 classes.
Of all the actual occurrences of each species, how many did the model correctly identify? Calculated per species then averaged equally across all 525 classes.
A single score that balances both precision and recall. Useful when you care equally about avoiding both false positives and false negatives.
